question: _______ shows the proportionate change in demand with respect to proportionate change in income.
solution:
The correct answer is **Income elasticity of demand.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Income elasticity of demand:**

 
 
• It measures how the quantity demanded of a good responds to a change in consumer income.
 
• A higher income elasticity indicates that demand for the good is more sensitive to changes in income.
 
• For financial enterprises, understanding income elasticity helps in predicting how changes in economic conditions will affect product demand.
 
• Goods with high income elasticity are often luxury items, whereas goods with low or negative income elasticity are necessities or inferior goods.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Product quality elasticity of demand:**

 
 
• This concept is not commonly used in economics. It might refer to how demand changes with changes in product quality, but it is not a standard measure.
 
 
 
• **Cross elasticity of demand:**
 
 
• Measures the responsiveness of demand for one good to a change in the price of another good.
 
• This is relevant for understanding substitute or complementary goods, not changes in income.
 
 
 
• **Price elasticity of demand:**
 
 
• Measures how the quantity demanded of a good responds to a change in its price.
 
• This is crucial for pricing strategies but does not involve changes in consumer income.
